en.title: Longest Subsequence Matching a Substring
en.description:
Given strings x and y, find the maximum length of a subsequence of x that is also a non-empty contiguous substring of y.

The input/output protocol and the explicitly marked constraints added by this site were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: Two lines with non-empty ASCII strings x and y; added by this site: |x|,|y|≤2000.
en.output: Output the required length; if no non-empty match exists, output 0.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach and proof.
